_ghi: Mẫu dài 16:9 The Geometry of Your Chart (đoạn trích): cung Mọc là gì. Vĩ độ San Francisco 37,8°; cung Mọc tính từ giao điểm hoàng đạo với chân trời đông.

cau.chu: Stand anywhere on Earth. The flat disc is your horizon.
“The Earth turns once in 24 hours, so all 12 signs pass over the eastern horizon in a day.” The gold circle is the zodiac.
Look east. “At the moment you were born, one of the 12 zodiac signs was coming up over the eastern horizon.” That point is your Ascendant.
“That works out to roughly two hours per sign.” “If your birth time is off by an hour, there's a fair chance your rising sign is wrong.”
“The Ascendant is marked on the left side of the wheel”
See your own Ascendant free at astrolas.com.
